en.io: Inputs raw user info dumps, document templates, and feedback; outputs structured document sections and reader-testing feedback.
en.boundary: It does not automatically generate finished documents without user interaction, nor does it directly publish or manage documents in external platforms.
scenarios: Drafting technical specifications, PRDs, RFCs, or architecture decision documents.
Structuring complex proposals by dumping unorganized project background and answering clarifying questions.
Testing document clarity by simulating how a fresh reader or AI will interpret the text to catch blind spots.

zh.io: 输入用户倾倒的信息、文档模板及修改意见，输出结构化的文档草案和盲点评估反馈。
zh.boundary: 该 Skill 不会在缺乏用户参与的情况下自动独立生成最终文档，也不会直接将文档发布到外部平台。
scenarios: 起草技术规范、PRD、RFC 或决策文档。
通过倾倒零散的项目背景并回答引导性问题，梳理复杂的提案文档。
模拟无上下文读者或 AI 的视角测试文档可读性，找出内容盲点。
